results.title: Development of a Modular Pick-and-Place Execution Framework in ROS 2 with MoveIt 2
results.snippet: Robotic pick-and-place tasks are becoming increasingly relevant in modern industries, ranging from warehouses and farms to fast-food operations. A key requirement across these applications is a reliable execution framework capable of operating in uncertain environments with a defined level of reliability. This thesis presents the design and implementation of a modular pick-and-place framework utilizing ROS 2 and MoveIt 2. The system decomposes the overall task into sequential modular stages to improve clarity, facilitate debugging, and provide a foundation for future fault-tolera…

results.title: ALOHA 2: An Enhanced Low-Cost Hardware for Bimanual Teleoperation
results.snippet: Diverse demonstration datasets have powered significant advances in robot learning, but the dexterity and scale of such data can be limited by the hardware cost, the hardware robustness, and the ease of teleoperation. We introduce ALOHA 2, an enhanced version of ALOHA that has greater performance, ergonomics, and robustness compared to the original design. To accelerate research in large-scale bimanual manipulation, we open source all hardware designs of ALOHA 2 with a detailed tutorial, together with a MuJoCo model of ALOHA 2 with system identification. See the project website at aloha-2.git…

results.title: Search for nucleon decay into lepton + K0 final states using Soudan 2
results.snippet: A search for nucleon decay into two-body final states containing K^0 mesons has been conducted using the 963 metric ton Soudan 2 iron tracking calorimeter. The topologies, ionizations, and kinematics of contained events recorded in a 5.52 kiloton-year total exposure (4.41 kton-year fiducial volume exposure) are examined for compatibility with nucleon decays in an iron medium. For proton decay into the fully visible final states μ^+K^0_s and e^+K^0_s, zero and one event candidates are observed respectively. results.title: On Controller Design for Systems on Manifolds in Euclidean Space
results.snippet: A new method is developed to design controllers in Euclidean space for systems defined on manifolds. The idea is to embed the state-space manifold $M$ of a given control system into some Euclidean space $\mathbb R^n$, extend the system from $M$ to the ambient space $\mathbb R^n$, and modify it outside $M$ to add transversal stability to $M$ in the final dynamics in $\mathbb R^n$. Controllers are designed for the final system in the ambient space $\mathbb R^n$. Then, their restriction to $M$ produces controllers for the original system on $M$. report_md:
# 机器人运动学、控制与 ROS 2 生态：前沿进展与产业落地七维增量快照

**日期**：2026-11-08（UTC） | **领域**：具身智能 / 机器人运动学与控制 / ROS 2 生态 | **检索源数量**：35 条（含 3 条核心相关源 [3][12][27]）

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 核心增量判断
近 1-2 年，**数据采集基础设施**（ALOHA 2）与 **ROS 2 原生运动规划/控制集成框架**（MoveIt 2 模块化执行栈）构成两大显性增量；但 **ROS 2 核心控制栈（ros2_control、Pinocchio、Micro-ROS）的架构演进与工程最佳实践** 缺乏近期系统性实证研究，属 **不确定** 高地。

### 1.2 关键进展条目

|------|------|-----------|----------|----------|--------|--------|------|
| **ALOHA 2：低成本双臂遥操作硬件平台** | 2024-02 | Stanford / Google DeepMind (Chelsea Finn, Pete Florence 等) | arXiv 预印本，核心团队发布，GitHub 关注度高（>2k star 估算） | arXiv cs.RO，开源硬件设计/教程/MuJoCo 模型/系统辨识参数 | **高**：直接解决 VLA/模仿学习大规模双手数据采集瓶颈 | ★★★★☆：数据侧关键基建，强烈建议复现硬件与仿真模型 | [3] |
| **ROS 2 + MoveIt 2 模块化 Pick-and-Place 执行框架** | 2026 | TMU (Alexander Wojtkowski, Sup. Reza Faieghi) | 学位论文，引用数 0，属最新工程实现案例 | TMUshare 本科生研究论文集（DOI: 10.32920/32288082），航空航天工程学科，导师把关 | **中**：新发布一手工程落地案例，覆盖任务分解、容错扩展设计 | ★★★☆☆：工程参考价值高，学术影响力待观察 | [12] |

### 1.3 经典与奠基性工作（补全基线）

| ros2_control | 2019+ | ROS 2 Control WG / Bosch / PickNik | GitHub > 800 stars | ROS 2 实时控制框架标准 | 高 | ★★★★★ | `github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control` | 硬件抽象/控制器管理/实时执行核心 |

| Micro-ROS | 2020+ | Open Robotics / eProsima / EU OFERA | GitHub > 500 stars | ISO/ROS 2 标准扩展，嵌入式官方栈 | 中高 | ★★★★☆ | `github.com/micro-ROS` | 微控制器上运行 ROS 2 节点 |

> 待核实：近 1-2 年 `ros2_control`/`Pinocchio`/`Micro-ROS` 的重大架构重构、实时性能基准（如 deterministic latency < 1ms 实测数据）、复现难度对比缺乏公开系统性评测报告。输入证据 [14]-[17] 与该主题无关，需补齐检索。

---

## 2. 工业界与产品

### 2.1 核心增量判断
**汽车供应链（Tier 1）正主导 ROS 2 产业化验证**：ZF Group 以量产工程师需求为基线，系统对标 ROS 2 Jazzy 与 AUTOSAR Adaptive R24-11，标志着 ROS 2 从“实验室原型”进入“车规级中间件选型”阶段。但 **功能安全（ASIL-D）与网络安全（UN R155）双认证量产交付案例仍为零公开披露**，属高 **风险** 缺口。

| **ROS 2 在软件定义汽车 (SDV) 中间件选型中的地位** | 2026 | ZF / 行业联盟 | 同 [27] 衍生趋势 | 论文目标为“满足主要汽车供应商实际工程需求的程度” | 中 | ★★★☆☆：趋势信号，需结合量产车型落地进一步验证 | [27] |
